tiers.name: test-fast
tiers.description: Typechecks and lints the workspace without running service, data, code-generation, or browser checks.

tiers.name: test-standard
tiers.description: Runs static, unit, API/data, and browser checks for the primary application validation.

tiers.name: test-standard-plus
tiers.description: Runs all non-Playwright validation, including isolated API code-generation checks.

tiers.name: test-heavy
tiers.description: Runs the complete validation suite, including API schema freshness and browser coverage.
